subject: IrisBridge connector + Watchtower instrumentation: sandbox gating & rollout
messages:
From: Emily Chan <emily@irisbridge.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood + IrisBridge connector — quick ask re: Watchtower hooks

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the intro at LLMCon — IrisBridge is excited about a lightweight connector to Redwood so our customers can route inference through your Dedicated and Private options. We have two asks to validate feasibility before we scope engineering effort:

1) Observability hooks: can Redwood emit an event stream / webhook for token-level sampling and request metadata (trace id, model variant, quantization profile)? We're planning a "Watchtower" integration that surfaces per-request telemetry in our dashboard.
2) Sandbox gating: for early partner access we'd like to run a controlled sandbox in us-west with RBW dev keys and simulated traffic. Any constraints on network/VPC peering or temporary credentials?

I've attached a short PDF with our proposed MVP (irisbridge-integration-mvp.pdf) and a one‑pager on Watchtower events.

Would love to set a ~30m sync early next week to align on scope and success metrics.

Best,
Emily Chan
Head of Partnerships | IrisBridge
emily@irisbridge.ai
[attachment: irisbridge-integration-mvp.pdf (pdf)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chan <emily@irisbridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood + IrisBridge connector — quick ask re: Watchtower hooks

Hi Emily — great to meet you at the conference, and thanks for the doc. Looping in Marissa (ISV integrations) and Kim (observability) so we can vet constraints quickly.

Quick answers up front:
- Observability: Redwood can emit structured traces and sampling events; we already offer per-request token sampling for a handful of partners via our Watchtower API. We'll need to confirm which fields (we redact customer prompts by default) and the retention window for the sample stream.
- Sandbox gating: We can provision a dedicated sandbox pool in us-west for partner pilot. We require a short security addendum and temporary IAM credentials tied to the sandbox. No VPC peering required for the initial pilot — just allowlist IPs and OAuth client.

Marissa/Kim — can you review the attached MVP and give bandwidth estimate and any blockers by EOD Tuesday? Emily, I'll send a meeting invite for Tue 11/31 (US PT) unless you prefer another time.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:47:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Redwood + IrisBridge connector — quick ask re: Watchtower hooks

Vanessa / Kim — quick internal take after skimming the MVP:

- Scope: Connector looks narrow (auth + routing + event hook). Estimate 3 sprints (2 engineers) for a sandbox-ready adapter (credential flow, simple shim for our SDK, routing knob).
- Observability: Watchtower events we can emit: trace_id, model_id, latency_ms, token_count, sampling_snippet_id (we cannot export full prompt text without customer opt-in). We should provide an option for redaction policies and a hashed user id.
- Security: Suggest a short POA (security addendum) and an SSO service account for the sandbox. No VPC peering is good — reduces ops overhead.

Action items for Tue meeting:
1) Confirm fields IrisBridge needs in the event payload (Emily) — especially whether hashed or raw user ids are required.
2) Draft sandbox credential expiry policy (Marissa).
3) Deliver a Watchtower event spec draft (Kim) for review.

I'll slot two engineers and a PM from Integrations if we agree on MVP.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
ISV Integrations Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chan <emily@irisbridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2026 16:38:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood + IrisBridge connector — quick ask re: Watchtower hooks

Hi Emily — thanks for the meeting earlier today. Per our sync, attaching the Watchtower hook spec (watchtower-hook-spec.md) and a proposed mutual action plan (mutual-action-plan-irisbridge.xlsx). Summary of decisions and next steps below: 

Summary decisions:
- Redwood will expose Watchtower events with fields: trace_id, model_variant, latency_ms, token_count, sampling_snippet_id, and optional hashed_user_id. Full prompt text will not be emitted unless customer opt-in is confirmed.
- We will provision a us-west sandbox pool with temporary credentials valid for 60 days. Sandbox access requires a signed security addendum.
- Initial MVP will include: OAuth-based credential flow, a lightweight connector plugin for IrisBridge routing, and a webhook endpoint for event delivery.

Next steps / owners:
- IrisBridge: confirm payload fields and whether hashed_user_id is sufficient (Emily) — due Thu 12/9
- Redwood Integrations: sandbox provisioning + credential policy (Marissa) — ETA 2 weeks
- Redwood Observability: Watchtower event JSON schema and sample webhook (Kimberly) — ETA 1 week
- Ops: provide sandbox IP allowlist and temp key rotation plan (Vanessa) — sending docs tomorrow

Emily, we'll open a HubSpot deal (HS-2026-137) and drop these artifacts into the shared Drive. If the team is happy with the timing we'll plan a dev handoff on Dec 14 to start the connector sprint.

Best,
Vanessa
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
